scaled_grasp_matrix: G = grasp_matrix(points).copy(); G[:3] /= length. min_singular_value: np.linalg.svd(G, compute_uv=False)[-1]. support: np.max(W @ u). epsilon_sampled: U = sample_directions(W.shape[1], n_dirs, seed); np.min(np.max(U @ W.T, axis=1)). is_force_closure: epsilon_metric(W) > tol.

primitive_wrenches: for each (p, n): nn = n / |n|; for f in friction_cone_edges(nn, mu, k): w = contact_wrench(p, f); without torsion append [w[:3] / length, w[3:]]; with torsion append it twice with (w[:3] + s * torsion * nn) / length for s = +1, -1. antipodal_min_friction: d = unit(p2 - p1); for (n1, d) and (n2, -d): c = d . unit(n); tan = sqrt(1 - c^2) / c (inf if c <= 0); return the max.

refine_direction: u = unit(u); for b in np.geomspace(20, 1e6, 1000): s = W @ u; p = np.exp(b * (s - s.max())); g = (p / p.sum()) @ W; g -= (g @ u) * u; u = unit(u - g / b). epsilon_metric: U = sample_directions(6, n_dirs, seed); h = max(U @ W.T, axis=1); best = h.min(); for i in np.argsort(h)[:n_refine]: best = min(best, support(W, refine_direction(W, U[i]))). rank_grasps: for each candidate, W = primitive_wrenches(pts, nrm, mu, k, length, torsion); (name, epsilon_metric(W), min_singular_value(scaled_grasp_matrix(pts, length))); sort by -epsilon.
